title: Example JSON Charter
objective: Implement the requested behavior at the source of truth and verify it through the repository's normal entry points.
successCriteria: The canonical owner implements the requested behavior.
Regression coverage proves the behavior through a real entry point.
Each completed task records structured completion evidence.
sourceTree: path: src/** owns production implementation owned by the active task
path: tests/** owns regression coverage for changed behavior
path: README.md owns setup and usage documentation
technicalStack: Use the repository's existing language, runtime, package manager, and test commands.
constraints: Non-control writes must match the active task's typed allowedWrites entries.
Every allowedWrites entry includes non-empty path, role, permitted, and forbidden metadata.
Record completion only after the task is actually complete and verified.
nonGoals: Do not rename public APIs or files unless the requested behavior requires it.
references: Repository specifications, design docs, or API contracts that define the requested behavior
verificationStrategy: Run the relevant build, test, typecheck, lint, or targeted inspection command.

tasks.title: Implement requested behavior at the owner
observedProblem: Visible behavior is wrong or incomplete.
requiredBehavior: The general behavior is correct through the canonical owner.
sourceOfTruth: User request, specification, API contract, design doc, or canonical test.
whyThisIsOwner: This path owns the behavior being changed.
downstreamConsumers: Tests and docs consume the behavior but must not reimplement it.
forbiddenImplementationPaths: Do not patch only the visible symptom.
rejectedShortcuts: Move ownership to a downstream consumer | the owner must implement the requested behavior directly.

permitted: implement the requested behavior at the source of truth
forbidden: move ownership into a downstream consumer

permitted: add or update tests that prove the owner behavior through real entry points
forbidden: weaken expected behavior to match an incomplete implementation

tasks.action: Update the owner implementation and the relevant regression coverage.
